coverageBoundary: Function IDs, source lines, and bytecode offsets refer to the full local Hermes disassembly at source above.

fields contains only literal FormData.append names, including genuine repeated categories[]/age_groups[]/files[] names. dynamicParts separately describes generated name patterns and individual member-value types. API routing/action/config values are not fields.

File-part values stay type unknown. React Native name/type/uri (or name/size/type/uri) descriptors are client file-part metadata, not nested multipart fields; filename alone does not establish a part name.
A complete local FormData append set does not establish server requiredness, accepted value types, a complete endpoint schema, or coverage of every caller.

Bundled FormData #2132 +0x0d-0x1f stores [name,value]; #2137 +0x27-0x39 uses the appended name for Content-Disposition, +0x6a-0xdc treats descriptor name/type as filename/Content-Type and native metadata, +0xe5-0xfc String(value) for scalar transport. #2127 +0xa4-0xb0 forwards getParts to native bridge. Metadata is never additional API properties; this is non-normative client transport evidence, not server/native completeness.
